author: Siva Sethumadhavan

pinnedSources.use: registries/controls, families, domains (15/90/360) and gate-mappings.csv roles
serialisations, canonical rules MDM-R01 to MDM-R20, conformance tests

gateRoles: Per-control CRITICAL and SUPPORTING roles from registries/controls/gate-mappings.csv (106 CRITICAL, 483 SUPPORTING mappings over 13 gates). The v1.2 synthetic gate-to-control lists are withdrawn.
scopeRule: Every registry CRITICAL control is in scope for its gate. Controls without a Control Assessment are NOT_ASSESSED. A gate with no assessed CRITICAL control, no evaluated criterion and no attached US4/US5 UNKNOWN is NOT_ASSESSED and applies its unknownCeiling (AIDCF-016 section 9.3).
